text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Juhu! Geschafft!
I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash~~~~!!
Congratulaaaations~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Danke schön!
Thank you so much for your support...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Standing here at Tokyo Racecourse
as a Derby Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I was able to become the victor once again...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaah...—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text: Flash...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Dad, Mom.
And... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Into this "bow"...
I pour all of my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash dropped to one knee on the turf with noble grace.
In that moment, she looked truly radiant—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Papa,Mama!

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
...It's been a long time
since you called me that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
...Dad, Mom.
choice_data_list: I'll excuse myself for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
!
I'm sorry, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, to avoid getting in the way of family time, I decided to leave the three of them alone for 'just a bit.'"

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Flash, first of all, congratulations.
That was a truly wonderful race."

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text: "You are our pride."

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, even if you do nothing,
you are our precious treasure.
That will never change."

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
""Yet you stayed true to your own path to the very end.
As one human being to another, you have my deepest respect.""

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Flash, you are truly a marvelous girl.
I'm so glad we came to watch after all!"

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"That was a run so wonderful it brought tears to my eyes. Truly—
super, toll, klasse!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I have returned.
Thank you very much for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they're heading back to the hotel after sightseeing in Tokyo.
...Do you think an evening outing request
would be approved if submitted now?
choice_data_list: I'll make sure it gets accepted.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...My parents told me.
That they are 'proud of me'..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Though there were twists and turns,
the goal was ultimately achieved.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I had given up on the schedule,
I wouldn't have felt this great sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for always encouraging me,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said it as though this were the end,
and it was hard to brush it off with a joke.
Because that end really was drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The only goal left is the Arima Kinen.
I'll run my heart out all the way to the "end"—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let us finalize a perfect schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As originally planned, she will likely retire.
If that is her own wish, I cannot say anything more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While recalling the sight of her running, I began
grappling with next year's race schedule—
